scripts.dev: pnpm run build:chapters:production && pnpm exec vite preview --config vite.gallery.config.js --port 5173
scripts.build:test: pnpm run wasm:release && vite build --config vite.config.js --mode test
scripts.build:current: pnpm run wasm:release && vite build --config vite.config.js
scripts.check: cargo check --workspace --all-targets && cargo check -p renderer-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && eslint vite.config.js vite.gallery.config.js playwright.config.js playwright.chapters.config.js eslint.config.js launcher web tests scripts && pnpm run check:coverage-policy
scripts.e2e:smoke: pnpm run build:test && SOFT_RASTERIZER_E2E_MODE=headless playwright test --grep @smoke
scripts.e2e: pnpm run build:test && SOFT_RASTERIZER_E2E_MODE=headless playwright test
scripts.e2e:headed: pnpm run build:test && SOFT_RASTERIZER_E2E_MODE=headed playwright test --headed
scripts.e2e:chapters: pnpm run build && pnpm run e2e:chapters:run
